title: Strong primordial inhomogeneities of axion-like field in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
summary: In this paper we consider complex scalar field with Mexican hat potential coupled with Gauss-Bonnet scalar resulting in restored U(1) symmetry at the stage of inflation, corresponding to the modern cosmological horizon. In our model, the phase transition takes place during inflation, avoiding large-scale axion isocurvature perturbations. Our model provides strong primordial inhomogeneities on small scales and ultra-light axion-like particle as either a fuzzy dark matter candidate or a candidate for inhomogeneous dark energy.
